## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run plugin:doctor` passes on the package I packed
- [ ] Fresh install in Genex, and a real harmless tool call from a chat
- [ ] Activation in the same chat (no new chat needed)
- [ ] Settings kept after updating from the previous version (or: first release)
- [ ] Disable and remove behave
- [ ] Account flow (or: no account)
